Worker.title: Worker
Worker.description: Represents an employee in the garment factory.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Worker entity.

designation.description: The worker's job title or position.

department.description: The department the worker belongs to.

joinDate.description: The date the worker joined the company.

contact.description: The worker's contact information (e.g., phone number, email).

photo.description: URL or path to the worker's photo.

qrCode.description: The QR code generated for the worker (e.g., URL or encoded data).

Attendance.title: Attendance
Attendance.description: Represents a worker's daily attendance record.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Attendance entity.

date.description: The date of the attendance record.

status.description: The attendance status (e.g., present, absent, late).

entryTime.description: The time the worker entered (if applicable).

OvertimeEntry.title: OvertimeEntry
OvertimeEntry.description: Represents a worker's overtime hours for a specific date.

id.description: Unique identifier for the OvertimeEntry entity.

date.description: The date of the overtime entry.

hours.description: The number of overtime hours worked.

ProductionEntry.title: ProductionEntry
ProductionEntry.description: Represents a worker's piece count for a specific date.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ProductionEntry entity.

date.description: The date of the production entry.

pieceCount.description: The number of pieces produced by the worker.

Salary.title: Salary
Salary.description: Represents a worker's salary for a specific month.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Salary entity.

month.description: The month the salary is for.

basicSalary.description: The worker's base salary for the month.

overtimePay.description: The worker's overtime pay for the month.

bonus.description: Any bonus received by the worker for the month.

productionPay.description: The worker's production pay for the month.

advanceDeduction.description: Any advance payment deducted from the worker's salary.

totalSalary.description: The total salary paid to the worker for the month.

AdvancePayment.title: AdvancePayment
AdvancePayment.description: Represents an advance payment made to a worker.

id.description: Unique identifier for the AdvancePayment entity.

date.description: The date the advance payment was made.

amount.description: The amount of the advance payment.

deductFromSalary.description: Indicates whether the advance payment should be deducted from the next salary.

BonusPayment.title: BonusPayment
BonusPayment.description: Represents a bonus payment made to a worker.

id.description: Unique identifier for the BonusPayment entity.

date.description: The date the bonus payment was made.

amount.description: The amount of the bonus payment.

type.description: The type of bonus (e.g., festival, performance).

Expense.title: Expense
Expense.description: Represents an expense incurred by the company.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Expense entity.

date.description: The date the expense was incurred.

category.description: The category of the expense (e.g., raw materials, utilities).

id.description: Unique identifier for the ActivityLog entity.

userId.description: The id of the user who performed the activity.

activityType.description: The type of activity performed (e.g., login, create, update, delete).

description.description: A description of the activity performed.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: Represents a single message in a chat.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ChatMessage entity.

senderId.description: The ID of the user who sent the message.

timestamp.description: The timestamp when the message was sent.

isRead.description: Indicates whether the message has been read by the recipient.

firestore.reasoning:
This Firestore structure is designed to support the GarmentFlow application's features while adhering to the principles of Authorization Independence, Structural Segregation, Access Modeling, and Data Clarity. The design uses path-based ownership for user-related data and prioritizes denormalization to avoid `get()` calls in security rules.

**Authorization Independence (CRITICAL):**

*   User-owned data (Attendance, OvertimeEntry, ProductionEntry, Salary, AdvancePayment, BonusPayment, Chat Messages) is nested under `/workers/{workerId}` or `/chats/{workerId}`. This enables simple security rules based on `request.auth.uid == workerId` without needing to read parent documents. The `workerId` is stored within each document where necessary, fully decoupling authorization from parent documents.
*   The `ActivityLog` collection stores the `userId`, enabling authorization based on the requesting user matching the logged user.

**Structural Segregation:**

*   Each entity type (Worker, Attendance, etc.) resides in its dedicated collection or subcollection. This ensures that all documents within a collection share the same security requirements.

**Access Modeling:**

*   Private data is modeled using path-based ownership (`/workers/{workerId}/...`, `/chats/{workerId}/...`).

**QAPs (Rules are not Filters):**

The structure facilitates secure `list` operations because:

*   All documents within a collection share the same security requirements, so listing is always secure.
*   Path-based ownership ensures that only the owner (or an admin) can list data within their paths.

**Invariants:**

*   The structure supports ownership invariants via path-based ownership enforced by security rules.

This design avoids hierarchical authorization dependencies and enables atomic operations (transactions/batches). The consistent naming conventions and explicit state modeling enhance debuggability.
